body:
<RamRod Sword of Baal> wrote...
> You sound more and more like a gay hating bigot that says he is gay to make your hate stories sound more plausible.

I don't care if you believe I'm gay, I assure you I really am.  My
attitude does seem odd, and yet it has kept me alive the last 15
years.  My brother got brainwashed by what I describe the gay cult
and is rotting away from AIDS because he believed all their
propaganda.

I'm not sure where I expressed "hate," I did not say I hated them
simply that I wouldn't touch them because I don't wish to catch
HIV, herpes, syphillis, anal warts, or any of the other 10,000
diseases ALMOST all of them are infected with.  I hate those
diseases, not necessarily the gay men who are infected with them.
Aldous Huxley once said that facts do not cease to exist simply
because they are ignored, and it's hard to ignore that it APPEARS
the vast majority of American homosexual men are infected with at
least one of the above nasty STDs (and tell me what you think the
HIV infection rate for Castro Street homosexuals might be, please
correct my claim with actual government statistics if you can
find them).

I really don't hate homosexuality, I watch "Will & Grace," "Queer
as Folk," John Waters and Pedro Almodï¿½var movies, etc.  It's just
the gay cult I hate, with its marxists demanding the usual civil
rights for gays, womyn, persuns of color, differently-abled, and
even aesthetically-challenged (ugly fat people), not to mention
the right of household pets to vote (but only if they vote for
John Kerry) and recyling.  They've taken all that crap and defined
it and themselves as representing gay people, that to oppose
anything on the list above (and the list is MUCH longer), that you
are a hateful, anti-gay bigot.  Like criticizing Jesse Jackson's
opinions makes you anti-black, criticizing their opinions makes
you anti-gay.

Here's a quote from St. Ted, and before you complain about my
admiration for a terrorist bomber, he still killed fewer people
than my own HIV+ brother (and Ted's IQ is literally about 100
points higher):

------------------------------------------------------------------
"Suppose you asked leftists to make a list of ALL the things that
were wrong with society, and then suppose you instituted EVERY
social change that they demanded.  It is safe to say that within
a couple of years the majority of leftists would find something
new to complain about, some new social 'evil' to correct because,
once again, the leftist is motivated less by distress at society's
ills than by the need to satisfy his drive for power by imposing

-- The Unabomber Manifesto; Paragraph 220
